approved: Foreign Acquisitions and Takeovers Fees Imposition Amendment (Fee Streamlining and Other Measures) Bill 2017

The coalition government argued the Foreign Acquisitions and Takeovers Fees Imposition Amendment Bill 2017 streamlines foreign investment fees, reduces red tape, and introduces a standard fee based on acquisition value. The speech defended foreign investment regulation by citing examples like the Kidman cattle station sale and Darwin port lease, and highlighted measures such as a vacancy charge on foreign-owned residential properties to boost rental stock.

The bill amends the Foreign Acquisitions and Takeovers Fees Imposition Amendment Bill 2017 to streamline foreign investment fees, reduce complexity, and introduce a 10 per cent fee increase for residential property applications to fund the Critical Infrastructure Centre.
